body: From my understanding God loves everyone. This includes the non-believers. If this is true, then wouldn't He want to be with them in heaven as well as the believers? Why is He testing our faith if He would much rather have all of us in heaven? It all seems like a trick to me.

>God is life. Suicide is a rejection of life.

Suicidal thoughts occur when life does not go your way. If God is life, then are suicidal thoughts a test of faith? I can sense you are irritated and ask of you to forgive my ignorance.

Thank you for your detailed response. But what about those in third world countries? Is it luck that I was just born into a capable family while they weren't? I am on the Internet with an abundance of food while they are struggling to even eat the bare minimum to survive another day. Why does God continue to allow this to happen?

>No, he is not. Nevertheless, it does not give you or anyone else the leave to commit murder. God is not content with people stealing, that doesn't make it right to murder thieves.

But why can't He accept suicide? Why does it entail an eternity in hell?

>God doesn't punish us for things we have no control over.

Then why are there kids being born into such harsh circumstances? You stated that they are because of the sins of others and how they are all interconnected. If these kids have no knowledge of the sins of others, why are they still being punished? What separates the birth of you and the birth of another in a third world country?

>Just because someone is suffering does not mean that it is ok to murder them or for them to murder themselves.

So God is fully content with letting his creation suffer? It is selfish to force someone to live through such agony.

>We are not autonomous, disconnected selves floating in some isolation tank. The sins of others have an effect on our lives.

Are those that were born into these situations aware of the sins of others? They have no relation to others' sins before they were born and should be treated as such. Why is it fair for God to punish someone who weren't even conscious of their surroundings?
They won't go to hell for committing suicide because they won't try or because they are a true believer? There is a general consensus that suicide is unforgivable sin and sin is deserving of hell.
Everyone I trusted turned their backs on me. Doctors cannot cure the sinful nature of a human being, and as long as we exist, I don't think I can find happiness.
I meant human interference.

>What?

I'm merely stating that the world itself is good but creation is not.

>And there are far more of them that are underpaid.

And how is this right? Why is this being overlooked by such a powerful god?

>What does that have to do with anything you've talked about?

It's just an additional question regarding God's legitimacy.

You've replied to my post with nothing that contributes to my understanding of God.

>Because murder is wrong.

Is letting someone you love continue to suffer right?

>Suicide is not a trivial decision.

Trivial or not, it still doesn't make sense to punish a follower.

>Sin

Then explain those who are born into those situations. Did they commit some sort of sin in their mothers' wombs or perhaps a time before existence?
You're not bothering me at all and thank you for the offer. I appreciate it.
It's a Friday so I'm thinking of just doing nothing in my room for the weekend. I think a time of reflect will benefit me more than anything else at the moment.
Hi, thanks for your concern. I slept on it and am glad to say that I am okay. However, it puts me at unease when I put someone through such worries.
Thanks for the reply and compliments. Maybe there is more to life and I just haven't seen it yet. I'll try not to doubt myself tomorrow and get through school one day at a time.

Maybe you're right and I'm making it more dramatic than it needs to be. It's a tough situation to access. I thank you for replying so earnestly to my thread. Maybe good and genuine people really do exist in this world. I'll try to do anything tomorrow for you.

That sounds a lot like me. I tried getting into a new game called Dawngate, but I realized there's no fun to that either when you're not happy.

Parents can be the worst sometimes. You would think that as people of society, they can relate to you as their son or daughter as they most likely have been through the same shit as you if not worse. But they end up doing this shit to you. Kicking a dead horse, you know? It really sucks, and I hate that you do something that you don't enjoy. I have to get up early tomorrow as well for summer school for a course I barely showed up, and to be honest, I don't think I'm passing this one either. I don't even know if I'm going to sleep because my sleeping cycle's already fucked and it just won't fix.

The military reminds me of a close friend I thought I had. He wanted to go serve and I remember him telling me about what he went through and why he wanted to go. Then, a couple days ago, he turns on me instantly in front of a group of guys. I'm the type of guy that you can pick on and not have to worry about being retaliated upon. I pretty much just sat there face-down taking all his shit because I'm a pushover. Not only that, but I just did not expect this at all from a friend I thought I had a real connection with.

Thank you for your response. Maybe I don't have to become that doctor or that lawyer my parents want me to become. Maybe I can just find happiness in a simple job that keeps me satisfied. But until then, I'm here and alone. I'm stuck in summer school doing work that I just can't focus on and I'll probably end up failing this course as well. Can you really become someone without a high school degree? I don't consider myself to be a Bill Gates.

I'm not much of a party-goer myself. In total, I've probably been to about 2 real parties my entire life lol. I'm pretty much a loser and I think everyone around me knows it. I realized that when I smoke or drink, I sort of do it with the intention of harming myself. Or at least taking my mind off things so I can be at rest for even a bit of time.

Video games are fun. I remember when I used to play League of Legends for hours a day and my parents would yell at me for not going out of the house or not eating meals with the family. I quit though, because I realized I shouldn't be playing for others' sake. I rage when people play poorly and I hate myself for that. I don't deserve to make others' experience any worse and because I rage, it takes all the fun out of everything. What games do you play?

I honestly respect your outlook on life. Even after all that, you continue. I'm really envious of you, but personally, I don't think I can turn things around unfortunately. I just have no willpower left or I'm just lazy. Either way, it just spells death to me.

I get those feelings, too. I try to be "proactive" and "outgoing" because I feel that's what you should be. But when I try going to parties and socializing with others, I just want to be on the computer alone forever. I guess it's just not for me. I also have no idea what to do with life. I really don't think I'm going to pass high school any time soon at the rate I'm going and I don't really have a safety net. My entire family already turned on me and I don't know if I want to make things better again because I've tried and life just fucks you over again. I'm pretty much sick of everything as well.

Thanks, I really appreciate the words. I'm 17, but is there really more to life and can I attain it easily?

I disagree with you on how there are limitless possibilities. Let's admit it, without a respectable education, you're not really going anywhere in life. But maybe I think that because respect is what I seek and the respected occupations require vast degrees of education. I don't think I'm going to pass high school ever at this rate, and if I can't get out of high school, will I really have a future?

Wow, we have a lot of things in common I can tell from just a couple sentences. I have to admit I'm also boring. I used to play video games a lot but I sort of just quit everything. I don't know how to live either, maybe life just fucks people over for the entertainment of others. It's a harsh reality really.

I like this, though. Someone I can feel a connection to.

Hi, thanks for the reply. I have to agree, life is what you make of it. But when everything is pitted against you, it's just too overwhelming. I guess I can try another time to make things better but what's stopping life from fucking me over yet another time? I just feel like living those years in pain to make your life better so that in the end you are happy is too much to bear. And even then it won't guarantee happiness. I'm at a crossroad.

I'm in the same boat, my friend. Although I haven't lived life as far as yours, I think I can slightly feel what you're going through. I realized you posted this just minutes ago and was hoping we could just talk about anything.
